name: ignore-cost-free-activation-with-empty-hand-is-not-refused
notes: ignoreCost path: Bertha, Spry Howitzer (ki6fxxgmue) is played for real with a Level 2 RANGER champion (patched to Diana, Deadly Duelist); her On Enter looks at the top 5 cards and activates Backstep (reserve 2) without paying its costs. The three payments for Bertha empty the hand, so a plain activation of Backstep would be unaffordable: the affordability gate must be skipped for ignoreCost activations. Backstep resolves (target: the champion) and ends in the graveyard with memory unchanged.

rulesClauses: Activate a Ranger action card with reserve cost 2 or less from among them without paying its costs.
